description: A more forgiving way of running your server. Each player receives a set amounts of stocks (lives) and they are banned once they run out. Made to solve the problem of deaths being cheap in small SMP servers, upping the stakes and as i theorize increase the longevity of a server beyond the 2-week phase

mods.name: LifeLedger
mods.description: Tired of players treating death like nothing? Give them lives, when they run out so do they! Adds some stakes to the SMP experience, highly configurable to accommodate different groups at different skill levels.
